title: Exploring hydrogen pipeline costs by considering regional geographical and political characteristics
abstract: arXiv:2505.01124v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Transporting hydrogen using pipelines is becoming increasingly relevant in the energy system, yet current cost estimates typically rely on simplistic approaches that overlook region-specific characteristics, leading to potential miscalculation of costs. Here we examine hydrogen pipeline costs by incorporating regional geographical factors, such as land use, topography and existing infrastructure, together with political-economic factors represented through country-specific weighted average costs of capital. Using a geographic information system-based model, we demonstrate that the regional levelized cost of transportation can vary by up to a factor of three. Comparing our approach with conventional ones based on uniform detour factors in an existing European energy system analysis framework shows substantial deviations in trade flows and highlights the relevance of this work. translated_title: 考虑区域地理与政治特征的氢气管道成本探究
translated_abstract: 在能源系统中，利用管道运输氢气正变得日益重要，然而目前的成本估算通常依赖于简单的方法，忽略了特定区域的特征，从而导致潜在的成本计算失误。本研究通过纳入区域地理因素（如土地利用、地形和现有基础设施），以及以各国特定的加权平均资本成本为代表的政治经济因素，来考察氢气管道成本。基于地理信息系统模型，我们证明了区域平准化运输成本的变化幅度可高达三倍。将我们的方法与现有欧洲能源系统分析框架中基于统一绕行系数的传统方法进行比较，结果显示贸易流存在显著偏差，凸显了这项工作的重要性。我们提供了4,900条潜在管道的成本和路线数据。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合区域地理因素（土地利用、地形、现有基础设施）与国家政治经济因素（加权平均资本成本）的氢气管道成本评估模型，发现区域平准化运输成本差异可达三倍，并显著改变了欧洲能源系统分析中的贸易流。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a GIS-based model for estimating hydrogen pipeline costs by incorporating regional geographical factors and country-specific political-economic factors, showing that regional levelized transportation costs can vary by up to a factor of three and substantially alter trade flows in European energy system analyses.
